subject: Modular Order Form — Exhibit mapping & implementation appendix alignment
messages:
From: Natalie Ortiz <natalie.ortiz@lumoshealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form — modularization ask

Hi Sergio / Laura / Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement at Lumos is asking us to make two contract adjustments before we can route the order for signature:

1) Break the Order Form into modular exhibits so we can onboard Phase 1 (pilot) and then opt into Phase 2 without re-signing the full MSA.
2) Add an "Implementation Appendix" (high level milestones + acceptance gates) into Exhibit C so our PMs and your delivery team have alignment and we can tie invoices to milestone completion.
3) We also want a price taper for months 4–12 on Phase 1 node-hours if we hit usage thresholds (details below).

I've attached a quick set of redlines (Lumos_redlines_v1.pdf) with inline notes. Key constraints from procurement: invoice cadence has to match milestone acceptance for Phase 1, and we need a clause that allows us to suspend provisioning for material QA failures with a 10-day cure period.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the legal redline and timeline for review? Our target is to get a countersigned Order Form by May 7 to meet our Q2 go-live.

Thanks,
Natalie Ortiz
Director, Vendor Ops — Lumos Health
Natalie Ortiz (attachment: Lumos_redlines_v1.pdf)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Ortiz <natalie.ortiz@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form — modularization ask

Natalie — appreciate the clear redlines and the timeline. Quick notes from our side:

- We can produce a modular Order Form that separates Phase 1 and Phase 2 via Exhibits (Exhibit C1 / C2). That allows Lumos to execute Phase 1 and then exercise Phase 2 via a single-sentence amendment (no re-signing of the MSA).
- Implementation Appendix: we agree. We'll map milestones to billing triggers (pilot acceptance, integration sign-off, ROI review). We need your PM to confirm the acceptance criteria for each milestone (I made a few guesses in comments).
- Price taper: feasible but need exact usage bands and whether the taper applies retroactively or prospectively.
- Suspension clause: we can add a 10-day cure window + remediation plan; legal will advise on exact wording.

Karthik is on copy for legal redlines. Laura — can you handle the commercial/implementation appendix mapping with Lumos' PM?

Proposed next steps:
1) Karithik to provide legal redline (MSA + order form) by EOD Wed Apr 22.
2) Internal SOW mapping doc (we'll use orderform_modular_template.xlsx) — Laura to start and share on Thu Apr 23.
3) 30-min triage call with Lumos on Fri Apr 24 to lock acceptance criteria.

If those dates look tight for you, push back and we'll adjust.

Thanks — will track this in the deal record (HubSpot 892374).

— Sergio
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(attachment: orderform_modular_template.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Natalie Ortiz <natalie.ortiz@lumoshealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form — modularization ask

Sergio / Laura / Natalie — I reviewed the Lumos redlines and sketched a set of edits (redlined_msa.docx attached). High-level legal items: 

- MSA: we should avoid a full re-execution mechanism; instead add an "Exhibit Amendment" pathway that allows one-party signature on the Order Form Exhibit and an automated referencing clause in the MSA (see §4.2 amendment path).
- Suspension language: oppose an unlimited unilateral suspension right. Counterproposal: Customer may issue a suspension notice, Redwood has 10 business days to cure; if cure fails we allow a temporary suspension limited to the impacted environment with pro rata invoice adjustments.
- Billing/Proration: recommend milestone-linked invoicing (non-refundable deposit for Phase 1 token allocation, remainder invoiced on acceptance). If Lumos wants retrospective tapering discounts, we need explicit volume thresholds and rollback rights in case of metric manipulation.
- Data residency and audit: add an exhibit note clarifying log retention for 90 days for acceptance evidence; Lumos asked for audit logs — we can provide aggregated telemetry but not raw KV cache dumps.

I attached the annotated docx and marked sections that require Lumos sign-off or product confirmation (implementation acceptance criteria). I'm ok to take the call on Fri to walk through the redlines.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redlined_msa.docx)

Karthik / Sergio — thanks, that set of edits looks reasonable at a high level. A few clarifications from our PM and procurement: 

- The price taper should be prospective only (apply to future invoices once a threshold is crossed). Procurement will provide exact bands by Monday.
- Acceptance criteria: our PM (cc'd) will send a one-page checklist per milestone by EOD Mon Apr 26. Please ensure the "Implementation Appendix" references that checklist as the source of truth.
- Suspension: Lumos is comfortable with the 10-business-day cure and the temporary, environment-scoped suspension.

Assuming legal and implementation mapping are complete after your updates, procurement will need a single consolidated PDF for our signature workflow (DocuSign). Could you send the consolidated Order Form + Exhibit packets with redlines accepted/declined highlighted? Our signing target remains May 7.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll be on the Fri triage call.

Best,
